01

8 phases, frame by frame

FlareLab splits one flare loop into eight phases. Drag the timeline or tap a phase number and the coach freezes on that frame; drag with one finger to see the hands and legs from any angle.

  • Scrub the timeline frame by frame
  • 0.25× / 0.5× / 1× playback
  • Rotate the view 360°
  • 7 coach looks to choose from
01
Rear supportLegs swing past the front
02
First transferWeight onto one hand
03
First side supportOne-arm support, high V
04
First leg passScissor legs to the front
05
Front supportHands behind, chest up
06
Second transferSwitch hands
07
Second side supportOne-arm support, high V
08
Second leg passSweep back, catch the next loop
02

17 muscle groups, highlighted live

For every phase the app lists the prime movers and the supporting muscles, split left and right by support hand. Tap a group to see what it does in that phase, what to watch for, and which drills train it.

  • Support (8): deltoids, rotator cuff, triceps…
  • Core (4): abs, obliques, erectors, hip flexors
  • Legs (5): glutes, hip abductors, adductors…
  • Jump straight from a muscle to its drills
03

51 drills in three levels (A/B/C)

Each of the 17 muscle groups has three drills: A bodyweight, B home equipment, C gym. Every drill comes with a 3D demo, sets and reps, form cues, common mistakes and a safety note, and you can filter by equipment or muscle.

  • A bodyweight · B home gear · C gym
  • 3D demo with slow motion
  • Sets, reps and form cues
  • Common mistakes and safety notes

04

Ready-made and custom plans

Start a ready-made session — warm-up activation, shoulder and arm support, the full flare chain — or build your own plan from the drill library. You can also describe your space and time in one sentence and let AI put a plan together.

  • Sessions for no equipment, home or gym
  • Custom plans: your drills, your order
  • AI plans from your space and time
05

Training log and milestones

Every session is saved automatically. The log shows your current streak, total sessions, total minutes and training days, this week at a glance and a 16-week heatmap. Streaks of 3, 7 and 14 days unlock milestones.

  • Streak and running totals
  • This week + 16-week heatmap
  • 3 / 7 / 14-day milestones

Start training in 4 steps

  1. 01Install

    After you sign up you get an invite: install via TestFlight on iOS or Google Play internal testing on Android.

  2. 02Pick a phase

    On the home screen, pick the phase you are stuck on and watch the coach and the muscles working in it.

  3. 03Train

    Open the drills for that muscle group, or start a ready-made plan, and follow the sets.

  4. 04Track

    Sessions save automatically; check your streak, heatmap and milestones in the log.

FAQ

Is it free?

Yes, the app is free during the beta.

Which devices are supported?

iPhone via TestFlight and Android phones via Google Play internal testing.

How do I join the beta?

Email mhgd3250905@gmail.com with your phone platform and the account email you will test with (your Apple ID for iOS, your Google account for Android). We send the invite to that address — just follow the link in it.

Does it need an internet connection?

The 3D demos and drill content work offline.

Which languages does the app support?

14, including English, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean and Spanish.

Is the training safe?

Drills are coaching advice, not medical prescriptions, with conservative volumes for beginner-to-intermediate breakers. Every drill has a safety note; stop if you feel pain or numbness.
